tagline: The marine and reef aquarium compatibility tool
description: Plan your marine or reef aquarium with confidence. Check saltwater fish compatibility, stocking limits, and care requirements using primary sources.

authors.name: Fish Scanner Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our editorial team verifies marine fish compatibility against primary aquaculture and scientific literature.

editorial.testing: All compatibility rules are verified against primary aquaculture literature, established hobbyist breeding logs, and marine biology databases. We do not rely on anecdotal forum posts.
editorial.monetization: We make money through affiliate commissions when you purchase aquarium supplies using links on our site.
editorial.corrections: To report a correction, please use the contact form. Our team will review the claim against primary sources and update the database if verified.
